name: @psyb0t/telethon-plus
summary: Wire an OpenClaw agent to a self-hosted docker-telethon-plus Telegram userbot over MCP — send/read/edit/delete messages, dialogs, media, chat admin, and polls as tools.
description: A thin stdio<->HTTP bridge that connects an MCP client (OpenClaw, Claude, Cursor, Codex, ...) to a running docker-telethon-plus instance's MCP endpoint (/mcp/), exposing its 34 tools over a REAL Telegram MTProto userbot account: send/read/edit/delete/forward messages, browse dialogs, resolve entities/contacts, download and send media, manage chats (create/join/leave/admin), and run polls. docker-telethon-plus is self-hosted — you run the server yourself, already logged into a Telegram account, and point this bridge at it. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-telethon-plus.

TELETHON_PLUS_URL.description: Base URL of your running docker-telethon-plus server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

TELETHON_AUTH_KEY.description: Bearer token, only if the docker-telethon-plus server was started with TELETHON_AUTH_KEY set.

url.description: Base URL of your running docker-telethon-plus server, e.g. http://localhost:8080 (the bridge appends /mcp).

token.description: Bearer token, only if the docker-telethon-plus server was started with TELETHON_AUTH_KEY set.
